title: Food delivery menus: a read-through cache that keeps serving old prices
name: Menu cache invalidation

questions.prompt: Restaurants complain that after changing a price or marking a dish sold out at dinner rush, the app keeps showing the old menu for up to ten minutes, and customers order dishes that are gone. Edits made late at night, when nobody is browsing, show up right away. Fix MenuService in menu/menus.ts so the tests pass.
